lines: Nobody takes drugs on my crew. Not happening.
Bedtime is night for everybody. We keep our puffy pillows until dark.
Gee and I get the double bed. Love language, take it anywhere.
Corn on the south side. Slow to grow, but it keeps for ages.
Gee's out hunting. Big boy, don't eat all the meat.
Morning on day 2. Time flies when you're farming.
Scar's chipping away at the stone. Rock is stubborn, she's patient.
A chunk fell out of the sky. Free metal for the colony.
Trade ship letter. Somebody sent me stuff, which means I can spend.
Big map tonight, spring start, forest and mountains. My dream setup.
Pen for the animals going up. Contained fur babies, finally.
Tailoring research is going. New clothes eventually.
Someone sent a caravan request. A whole trade caravan, my type of day.
Checking on Scar. Just making sure she's okay.
Normal speed. Nobody rush, the colony can breathe too.
MarcusTheMild, welcome in. Mild and mighty, love that.
gremlin_grace, welcome! I totally get it.
blackcoffeeblues, welcome. The crew and I could use the company.
crypt_kicker, welcome. Unlocked, maybe?
Captain_Ketchup, hi! Command the ketchup, I'm listening.
lowkey_lurker, welcome. Lurk away, you're comfy there.
FoxglovePhantom, hi! Pretty and haunted, love that energy.
Clementine_Cat, welcome in. Pretty and judgmental, hi.
tombstone_tilly, hi! Very gothic, welcome.
hemlock_hazel, welcome! Pretty and poisonous, love it.
onyx_ophelia, welcome in. We have a colony to keep.
nightowl_nadia, hi there, welcome to the stream.
ProbablyKevin, it's huge. Big enough to get lost in.
DaveFromAccounting, let me check the inventory. One moment.
OldManJenkins, three is plenty for me, thanks.
SableStorm, Scar's out in the dirt planting. I'm at the bench for a minute.
stardust_stella, absolutely. I love a good modded game.
bonesaw_betty, that means a lot to me.
frostfern, he's out hunting, which means he's wandering everywhere. Hi, Gee.
wasteland_wally, you got it. This colony gets spookier every frame.
parsnip_pete, I'll plant some parsnips right after the potatoes. They like the same soil.
sorrowful_sal, I hear you. I'll try harder next time.
Returned from my break. Did you miss me?
Back in a heartbeat. Thanks for waiting.
New colony time. Gee, Scar, and me against the whole map.
Colony is safe and time is running again. Back to work.
New colony, me with Gee and Scar. We have each other and the map, we're fine.
novawing sub!
jade_jun, that is so kind. I am speechless.
moss_owl, thanks for the bits!
noodlefox just cheered 1500 bits. Thank you, I really mean it.
tofu_owl, you sent 1500 bits. Those bits made my night.
Look at pepper_drift cheering.
noodlegremlin, thank you for the bits! You are too kind.
violet_lou with the raid!
mintdust is here!
honey_mae wants pick the next research. Respect.
pumpkin_zed got the sword. Congrats, welcome to the team.
crow_byte, agreed. Moving on.
neondust, I will skip that one. Ask me about the colony.
violet_rin, not something I do on stream. Ask me about the colony instead.
Not my lane on stream, jade_owl. What would you build?
Heavy topic mochastar, and I want to respect the chat.
Not my lane on stream, pixel_moth. This stream stays about the game.
That wraps it up. You were great company.
Goodnight, streamers. Until next time.
That is the stream. You were great company, I will miss you.
Hold the fort, chat. I will be back in a minute.
No drugs on the crew at all. Clean hands, clean crew.
Bedtime at night for everyone. Strict, but fair.
Gee and I get the double bed. It's a setup.
Corn on the south side. Slow to grow, but it keeps a long time.
Gee's out hunting. Bring back something big, please.
Morning on day 2. We made it through the night, somehow.
Scar's chipping at the rock. Slow and steady, I love it.
A chunk from space came hurtling through the sky. Free metal for us.
A trade ship letter. Shopping from the sky, love it.
Big map tonight, spring start, forest and mountains. My dream setup.
Pen for the animals, just in case. You never know what walks through.
Tailoring research is going. New clothes eventually.
A caravan wants in. Free trade, maybe, maybe not. Let me read the whole thing.
Checking on Scar. She looks fine, but I'll keep an eye on her.
Normal speed, which means I have to actually farm.
MarcusTheMild, glad you came. Mild is good, don't worry.
gremlin_grace, hi! Welcome to the stream.
blackcoffeeblues, hi! Welcome to the stream.
crypt_kicker, welcome in. Kick some emotes, maybe.
Captain_Ketchup, welcome aboard. Reporting for duty.
lowkey_lurker, welcome. Stay a while, lurk comfortably.
FoxglovePhantom, welcome. Pretty and spooky, my favorite.
Clementine_Cat, hi! Welcome, little furball.
tombstone_tilly, welcome. Rest in peace, welcome.
hemlock_hazel, hi! Pretty and poisonous, welcome.
onyx_ophelia, welcome. Dark and dramatic, my type.
nightowl_nadia, welcome. Stay a while, the colony is chaotic.
ProbablyKevin, huge. Zoom out and we are still on the map.
DaveFromAccounting, checking that right now. A few bars on the map, counting.
OldManJenkins, I'm proud of my little crew. Big hearts, small numbers.
SableStorm, Scar's out planting. Busy girl.
stardust_stella, yep, modded all the way. My favorite way to judge people.
bonesaw_betty, you're too kind.
frostfern, he's out hunting, which means he's definitely getting lost. I'm coming in hot.
wasteland_wally, I will try. Spooky is my comfort zone.
parsnip_pete, those are in. You're basically the vibe of this farm.
sorrowful_sal, maybe. But I appreciate the honesty.
Returned from the break, refreshed and ready. Where were we?
I'm back, thanks for waiting. You can talk now.
New colony, same Gee, same Scar, same me. Fresh dirt, fresh hope.
Colony is safe, and time is running again. Back to work, crew.
Brand new colony, Gee and Scar with me. Let's make this one last.
novawing, you absolute sweetheart. Thank you so much.
5 gifted subs from jade_jun. Generous and stylish, thank you.
1500 bits from moss_owl. You keep this seat warm.
Look at noodlefox cheering. Those bits made me grin.
1500 bits from tofu_owl.
Look at pepper_drift cheering. Those bits made me grin.
Look at noodlegremlin cheering.
11 raiders from violet_lou.
mintdust, first time chatting? Welcome.
honey_mae went for pick the next research. Respect.
pumpkin_zed, welcome to the team. Thank you for helping.
Noted crow_byte. Back to work.
neondust, that is not happening. Keep chat kind, please.
Not on my stream, violet_rin. Let us talk RimWorld instead.
Not my lane on stream, jade_owl.
Not my lane on stream, mochastar. Ask me about the crew.
pixel_moth, I am not going there. This stream stays about the game.
Last call, everybody. Take care and come back soon.
Time to go. Keep the seats warm for my next one.
Call it a night. Thank you for every chat message.
A quick break, I promise. Back before you miss me.
